Decorate your zoo with items like the Flag Fence, the William Tell Statue, or the golden Boot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31143502/cefcc24e81ca471d05efa7a573987fc072d7a473.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Each decoration has a set “trophy” value. When the event ends on 9 July at 11:00 CEST, we’ll count all your trophies—and you’ll be able to claim your rewards![/p][p]In addition to Gold and Diamond Boosters, two animals are waiting for you: the Tiger quoll and the Abruzzo Chamois.[/p][p]The grand prize? Two Marsh Mongooses![/p][p]Have fun and enjoy the football event in My Free Zoo![/p]

notes.title: My Free Zoo - Partner Zoo
notes.notes:
From now on, your zoo will be even clearer - without any compromises! The brand new partner zoo is now available in the game and gives you the opportunity to outsource animals without sacrificing experience points or visitors. Quite the opposite: you get all the bonuses as usual - just with more freedom and better performance.

🏞 How the partner zoo works:
[list]	[*]You can reach it via a new building next to your main zoo[/*]	[*]It is divided into region areas – from grassland to jungle to ice.[/*]	[*]You can donate animals as soon as you have at least two specimens in the main zoo or in a region.[/*][/list]
[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0514_2025_MFZ_partner_zoo_640_250.jpg[/img]

This gives you more overview, reduces loading times and at the same time gives you the opportunity to continue collecting experience points and visitors - all automatically.

🎁 And that's not all:

You will receive progress points for caring for the animals in the partner zoo, which you can use to gradually unlock exclusive rewards - including new employee vouchers and special enclosure decorations. Your own employees at the partner zoo will also help you to automatically collect XP pins.

notes.title: New Stone Age animals in the museum
notes.notes:
Now you can explore six more animals in the Stone Age section of the museum in My Free Zoo. You can find the new additions on the second page of the Stone Age tab.

There you can dig up fossils for Andrewsarchus, Chalicotherium, Daeodon, Bos Priscus, Megaceros, and Ursus Spelaeus. From these you can assemble skeletons to display them in the museum, or you can make animal parts directly and bring the ancient animals back to life.

[img]https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0319_2025_MFZ_stone_age_expansion_640_250.jpg[/img]

Of course, you can then place the new animals in enclosures and attract lots of new visitors.

Have fun with the Stone Age expansion in My Free Zoo.

notes.title: Polar expedition in My Free Zoo
notes.notes:
My Free Zoo isn’t lounging at home for the Christmas event but embarking on an exciting polar expedition. Specifically, it heads to the Arctic, inspiring decorations you can place in your browser-based zoo.

How about ice crystals, sliding penguins, or the expedition ship? These are just a few decorations available for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31143502/0939a45d819959617b39b5d07fd624f7a6d47082.jpg[/img]

Additionally, you can buy two exclusive decorations for your favorite fellow players. Each event decoration holds a fixed crystal value.

At the event's close (December 20, 11 AM), we'll tally your crystals, and you can claim your rewards. Boosters await along with the common porpoise, Humboldt penguin, and North Indian muntjac.

Alongside the event, two new Christmas decoration collections are available. You can snag the Christmas light chain and reindeer headband from here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31143502/6e22fbd0a982059b46658c12a61876880447c17e.jpg[/img]

Lastly, an old bonus animal makes a return to the shop. If you've hit level 141, you'll now find the spectacled bear available there.

notes.title: My Free Zoo - It's getting colorful!
notes.notes:
Promotions, animals, new features - the most exciting week of the year in your browser zoo has begun.
The Black Friday week brings an entirely new feature to the browser zoo: the Designer Shop. You'll find this new building from Level 29 in front of the main entrance. With this, you can equip your animals with special items from four categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31143502/48eb9b809905d435e258e1ec122a29a5ac2f70a2.jpg[/img]

In addition, you can give your animals special effects and sounds that play when you take care of them. Furthermore, you can change the ground in the enclosure here.

To give you a glimpse into the new feature, you'll receive a package of seven items when logging in until November 29th. With this, you can test for free if you like the innovation.

Additionally, with the Designer Shop, a new mixed enclosure comes into play. There, you can place various animals, but they all need to be equipped with the new items.

notes.title: New: Polar Park
notes.notes:
With the beginning of winter up ahead, My Free Zoo is ready for the new [b]Polar Park[/b].

First, you need access to the Zoological Society in order to gain entry to the new region [b]starting at level 25[/b].

There, many of your favorite [b]ice enclosure[/b] animals will find a home much like their natural habitats.

On top of more than forty existing animals, two new exclusive animals are ready to move in as well: the [b]white sperm whale[/b] and the [b]Rock ptarmigan[/b].

The ptarmigan is available as a special reward for the collector's album achievements "[b]Polar Starter[/b]" and "[b]Polar Specialist[/b]".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31143502/0209fdc27afaa6e0e964e3c288326667de5bbe9e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.notes:
[h1]Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games[/h1]

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the [b]Halloween-Events[/b] starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

[h1]My Little Farmies[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From [b]October 22nd to 29th[/b] the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the [b]Shrunken head[/b]-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new [b]„Saddler‘s“[/b] production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

[h1]My Free Zoo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect [b]Lionhead tokens[/b] at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive [b]Siberian musk deer[/b] to exhibit in your zoo. ([i]The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.[/i])

[h1]My Free Farm[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The [b]Halloween card-matching game[/b] is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. ([i]October 22nd 
through to November 5th[/i].)

But also your  [b]Horse Farm[/b] (24 – 30 October), [b]Wauies[/b] (24 – 31 October), [b]My Sunny Resort[/b] (23 – 30 October) and [b]My Free Farm 2[/b] (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Little Imps available now!
notes.notes:
The quiet days are over! The sound of numerous imps working to expand the underground lair puts a smile on the face of even the most miserable rules of the deep. With its humorous fantasy elements, its online coop mode and unique battle features, dungeon tycoon game „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is the right game for any aspiring prince of darkness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026505/9b43b55f5a92a4f01249e20ff71909953a39fbaf.jpg[/img]

The Steam early access version of „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is now available.

notes.title: Axolotl as bonus animal for 275 and 300 placed specimen
notes.notes:
My Free Zoo is expanding its collection book and achievements to cover 275 and 300 placed animals in your zoo.

With an ever expanding amount of animals you can display in your zoo, the number of specimen listed in your [b]collection book[/b] is growing as well. So now we are rewarding players who have more than 275 animals in their zoo with the newest addition: the [b]Axolotl[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/2287b3f0b8d69e17e63cfcc2a7b6143ce9dc7c2b.jpg[/img]

This purely aquatic amphibian can only be found in a certain lake near Mexcico City. Thanks to the drying up of close-by lakes and water pollution, this formerly aztek holy animal has become almost extinct.To complete your collection you may find missing animals in our daily [b]Hot Deals[/b] in the coming weeks. 

Right now you will find the [b]Pygmy Hippopotamus[/b] as an alternative to the Yeti Mascot in all packages of 100+ diamonds as [b]bonus item[/b].

Should you be looking for an animal to add to your forrest or jungle enclosures, cards for the Diana Monkey can now be found diamond boosters. So with a bit patience and luck this noisy fellow can be yours soon.

notes.title: Start of the 2018 Christmas Event
notes.notes:
[h1]Decorate your zoo, collect snowflakes and win cute Chamois[/h1]

Are you too dreaming of a white Christmas? The world of [b]My Free Zoo[/b] already is covered under a cozy blanket of snow dotted with seasonal decorations everywhere.​

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/ab5998d37e9ec5db0a455256e20fb67500fd5295.jpg[/img]

[b]Between December 5 and 19[/b], you may decorate zoo with [b]Christmas decorations[/b] - ranging from a nativity scene to the frozen lake, complete with ice skaters, you will find many elements that create a festive ambiance.

Every decoration placed adds to your „snowflake score“, which is added up at the end of the event and exchanged for a rare animal.

This year, next to the [b]Sable[/b] and the [b]European Sturgeon[/b], we are introducing the [b]Chamois[/b] to the Zoo. The first of these rare animals can be yours for only 20,000 snowflake points.

We hope you enjoy a wonderful Christmas season and wish you success decorating.

notes.title: Special advantages, a free trial, the Children‘s Farm
notes.notes:
Today we released one of [b]the biggest My Free Zoo updates[/b]: The Children‘s Farm and Premium Accounts!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/34c0f7422116c9bff91d9e5a2bba0d6b87503a67.jpg[/img]

Create your [b]Children‘s Farm[/b] and start collecting [b]Premium Coins[/b]. Collect enough coins and redeem them to enjoy [b]numerous advantages[/b] from [b]more exprience points[/b], reduced waiting times, to more friendship slots, better breeding chances and much more.

Starting from level six, all players can access the new Children‘s Farm region, build decorations and gather Premium Coins.

Explore the exciting, gigantic, colorful and advantageous new content in [b]My Free Zoo[/b] now!

notes.title: My Free Zoo: Prehistoric animal collection, Booster Upgrade, Expansions
notes.notes:
his time My Free Zoo boasts with exciting new features and events! First of all we expanded the [b]Zoo d'Amour, Serengeti, and Prehistoric Park[/b] regions to accomodate more animals. There are 4 expansions per region available.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/b6de447559e46fa1ef8bdf7d9e6812f6ff7e97ab.jpg[/img]

To help you fill this space, we are upgrading the bronze to [b]silver boosters[/b] between the [b]22 November, 0:01h CET and the 28 November, 23:59h CET[/b]. Remember: if you log in on three+ consecutive days you will even get the gold booster!

Dinosaur fans will also get their fair share of excitement: We are adding the [b]prehistoric animal collection[/b]. Collect all 25 dinos once to achieve one [b]Spinosaurus[/b] for your [b]Prehistoric Park[/b] or 3 each to start breeding your Spinosauruses!intern

notes.title: Menagerie and Alaska Day Event
notes.notes:
[h1]A new region and 24 hours Alaska Day event[/h1]

Good news for zoo directors with an extensive circle of friends: The Zoological Society has opened up a new region: the Menagerie.

Of course you will have to own the Zoological Society and fulfill a few tasks to unlock this new region.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/69e28bc6270a70faffc6ef9f99494069e3367a8b.jpg[/img]

After this, it will offer all the challenges and amenities the normal zoo offers, but will grant you full friendship stars for completed tasks, giving you access to valuable rewards quicker.

In honor of the new region we will be celebrating Alaska Day on October 18th.

For 24 hours, breeding times and costs will be halved for many animals typical for the Americal polar region, like the American Black Bear, Kodiak bears, Bold Eagles, Narwhales and the like. On top of this, every successful breeding completed within that period will reward the proud parents with twins.

We wish you a a lot of fun with the new Menagerie and the Alaska Day celebrations!

notes.title: Fall in the Himalayas
notes.notes:
Far East scents waft through My Free Zoo. This year's Autumn Event whisks you away to the Himalayas.

Turn your zoo into a Tibetan mountain village with ginseng, Buddhist structures and the national drink - Yakbutter Tea!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/5a0fa7a05c190977f09033b79934f1e1fe22653d.jpg[/img]

This decoration event will also let you earn a fitting animal for the scenery: the Tibetan Sand Fox, which you can keep in rock, savanna and ice enclosures.

If you missed them the last few years, you'll also have the chance to get gaurs and elks for your zoo. You'll have until [b]September 19[/b] at 10:59 am CST to decorate your zoo and collect prayer flags.

Come visit the world's highest mountain range and take part in My Free Zoo's Autumn event!

notes.title: Collect Amazonian Animals and Earn Prizes
notes.notes:
There's a new challenge waiting for you in My Free Zoo: the [b]Amazonian Collection[/b]. You'll find it in your [b]achievements menu[/b] which you can access by clicking on the trophy in your main menu bar.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/f1928fc116446a4c3c29777c21f800331db16696.jpg[/img]

There are [b]two parts[/b] to the [b]Amazonian Collection[/b]: [b]Amazonian Land Animals[/b] and [b]Amazonian Water Animals[/b]. For each of these tasks, you need to breed [b]10 specimens[/b] of specific Amazon animals and release them. These include jaguars, marsh deer, giant otters and Amazonian dolphins.

 As soon as you've bred and released all required animals for each part, you'll get a [b]Bald Uakari[/b]. This special Amazonian monkey has a scarlet face. Bald Uakaris live in groups in the treetops and feed primarily on fruit.

 The Uakari can [b]only be obtained through the Amazonian collection[/b]. Each part (water and land) will give you one Bald Uakari. Upon completing both parts, you'll have two Uakaris to [b]breed[/b]!

 Come stop by your zoo! You'll find everything you need to know in the game!

notes.title: Collect Pieces of This Exotic Bear
notes.notes:
You can now find [b]at least one piece[/b] of the brand-new [b]Sloth Bear[/b] in every [b]bronze booster[/b].

This unusual bear primarily occurs in [b]India[/b] and prefers to feed on [b]insects[/b]. It has a long, slender tongue, shaggy, mostly black fur, and long, sickle-shaped claws.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/21b9851066b0c1fceee884f5cbd6e34a7614e528.jpg[/img]

To get your very own Sloth Bear, you'll need [b]100 card pieces[/b], which you can collect from boosters or trade with friends. In [b]every 200th booster[/b] opened worldwide, you'll find [b]eight sloth bear card pieces[/b]! Come get your first card piece now!

By the way, from now [b]until Wednesday, August 15[/b], at 11:00 am CEST, you can take advantage of the [b]double booster week[/b] in My Free Zoo. When you buy a bronze, silver or gold booster, you'll get a [b]second booster[/b] of the same type [b]free[/b]!

Expericence this [b]wonderful opportunity[/b]!

notes.title: The Superstores Are Here!
notes.notes:
Wow your Visitors with Food, Drinks and Souvenirs!

Now you have new options for pampering your guests in My Free Zoo with food, drinks and souvenirs: the [b]superstores[/b] are here! There are two types of superstore: [b]gourmet stores[/b] and [b]souvenir stores[/b]. Each of these is available in [b]three tiers[/b] - super, mega and giga stores.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/00e246e760954aa7a45677d2acf4c76cc7beb0e1.jpg[/img]

There are two ways to get a [b]superstore[/b]:

[b]Option 1:[/b] You can buy the superstore for Diamonds straight from the zoo shop.

[b]Option 1:[/b] You can trade in existing shops for a superstore. 

[u]This is how it works:[/u] 

You'll need a [b]large shopping mall[/b] filled with shops. You can decide, if you would like to turn it into a [b]gourmet store[/b] or a [b]souvenir store[/b].

Once you have clicked on your choice, you can [b]remove all decorations, paths and not-relevant shops[/b] from your mall with the simple click of a button.

[u]Example:[/u] 

If you decide to turn your mall into a gourmet store, you'll remove all decorations, wallpapers, paths and souvenir shops, so that food and drink shops are the only thing that remains.

 You can then you can transform your store. Depending on how many shops (and they money they could make) you had, your mall will be turned into a [b]super, mega or giga store[/b].

The advantage of a superstore are twofold: You [b]save time[/b] because you don't have to collect your ZD income as often and only need to click one pin and they use up significantly [b]less space[/b] than a mall.

You can find detailed instructions with everything you need to know in the game. Stop on by and discover the possibilities!

notes.title: Super Twin Week!
notes.notes:
Your Zoo might as well be an aquarium with all the animals currently playing around in their watering holes. Fresh mommies are grateful for the break - they can just doze on a nearby rock with one eye watching the gamboling youngsters. Yep, another [b]Twin Breeding Event[/b] has begun with today's patch!

This means that every successful breeding [b]completed[/b]* before [b]Wednesday, July 4th, at 10:59 am CEST[/b] will grant you [b]twins[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/6d445e120135d19e253636ebda388900c840414e.jpg[/img]

In addition to the two baby animals, all [b]players who breed twins will also receive twice the experience[/b]. And if the breeding wasn't successful? All players will receive [b]twice the experience[/b] anyway, as a bit of a consolation prize.

For the first timer ever, you can also enjoy the benefit of [b]50% off of fertility feed[/b]! Significantly increase the chance of getting not one, but two baby animals at an unbelievably low price!

[b][i]Please note: [/i][/b]The experience bonus is already calculated into the pop-up display that appears for your information after a successful breeding.

*Breedings must [b][i]complete[/i][/b] during the event period; breedings that were started during the event will not result in twins once the event expires.

notes.title: World Cup Event
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Zoo Directors[/b],

[i]"In Soviet Russia, country comes to you!"[/i] Football fever is rampant in the zoo, and you can now get a closer look at the World Cup's host country in this year's [b]World Cup Event[/b]! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/e8c35a2e2918737d58c3664e73f92a975a872a7f.jpg[/img]

For the duration of the event, you'll find the seasonal section of your shop stocked with impressive [b]Russian landmarks and international banners[/b] - use them to show your enthusiasm for your team and this year's enchanting host country!

Each World Cup decoration you place in your zoo will give you points in the form of [b]Footballs[/b] at [b]regular intervals[/b]. Just click on the [b]pin[/b] that appears above them to collect your Footballs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/f6042565c36e54a7b1d02782a4c8738d9a43263e.jpg[/img]

One special decoration - the [b]King's Gate[/b] - will instantly give you 7,500 Footballs when you charge it for 10 Diamonds.

You can click on this icon at the right side of your playing field to see your progress. Collecting enough Footballs before the event ends on [b]July 11 at 10:59 am CEST[/b] will allow you to earn [b]3 awesome animals[/b] for your zoo!

You can also help out your friends by sending pieces of two [b]exclusive World Cup friendship gifts[/b]!

Prizes include two former prize animals, the Arapaima and the Kea, as well as a brand-new animal, the Raccoon Dog!

[list]
[*][b]50,000 Footballs[/b] - Arapaima
[*][b]100,000 Footballs[/b] - Kea
[*][b]200,000 Footballs[/b] - Raccoon Dog
[*][b]400,000 Footballs[/b]- Arapaima
[*][b]600,000 Footballs[/b] - Kea
[*][b]750,000 Footballs[/b] - Raccoon Dog[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/cbd3fc9e10da3c614d2f7891623469760ce75869.jpg[/img]

While bearing an uncanny resemblance to raccoons, the [b]Raccoon Dog[/b] is actually a canine. Native to Eastern Asia - its Japanese name (tanuki) is also quite popular - it was introduced to parts of the Soviet Union between 1928-1958. It is now abundant in large parts of Eastern Europe. Raccoon Dogs are good fathers, helping the females raise their litters. In your zoos, these furry bandits will feel most comfortable in [b][i]forest and ice enclosures[/i][/b], where they take up [i]six fields[/i] of space and can be kept in [i]groups of ten[/i].

Enjoy the game!

Your [b]My Free Zoo[/b] Team

notes.title: Serengeti Collection
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Zoo Directors,[/b] 

Summer's here, and while the lions and antelopes are busy scratching at pesky flies, we bet you're itching for a challenge! We have just the thing for you: the all-new Serengeti Collections!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/67a8880d54ad0126a57be942b930a187e3f10066.jpg[/img]

Just like previous collections, you'll find these new challenges in the [b]"Animal Collection"[/b] tab of the [b]achievement menu[/b] (the trophy/250 in the main menu bar):

There are two challenges, [b]Serengeti Beginner[/b] and [b]Serengeti Specialist[/b]. You want details? Then have a look at the spoiler!*

Missing some of the required animals? Keep an eye out for some [b]hot deals[/b]!

Each of these tasks rewards a [b]Kirk's Dik-Dik[/b] - a brand new animal for your [b]Serengeti Region[/b]! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/77fcab994f5c39dd15846d1d15708aec3c3a95c2.jpg[/img]

Weighing at most just over 7kg, Kirk's Dik-Dik is the largest of the Dik-Diks, the world's smallest antelopes. These quaint nocturnal creatures are well-adapted to their hot and arid habitat. Their large ears and strange snout help them keep cool, and they make sure to always eat the juiciest plants to stay hydrated!

These tiny ungulates [b]can be kept exclusively in Serengeti (or Serengeti breeding) enclosures[/b], which limits them to being kept in the Serengeti and the Zoo d'Amour, which can be unlocked through the [b]Zoological Society[/url][/b].

Enjoy the game! 

Your [b]My Free Zoo[/b] Team 

*[b]Serengeti Beginner[/b]: [spoiler]Release 10 mature adults of each of the following species: African Elepfant, African Wild Dog, Bat-eared Fox, Black Rhinoceros, Caracal, Cheetah, Greater Flamingo, Ground Pangolin, Hippopotamus, Honey Badger, Impala, Leopard, Meerkat, Nile Crocodile, Southern African Lion, Spotted Hyena[/spoiler]

[b]Serengeti Specialist[/b]: [spoiler]Release 10 mature adults of each of the following species: Aardwolf, African Buffalo, Black-backed Jackal, Black Wildebeest, Dromedary, Grey Crowned Crane, Ground Hornbill, Kori Bustard, Mhorr Gazelle, Nile Monitor, Oryx, Red River Hog, Sable Antelope, Secretarybird, Shoebill, Yellow-billed Stork[/spoiler]

notes.title: Turtle Day
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Zoo Directors[/b],

May 23rd is [b]World Turtle Day[/b], celebrating our favorite shelled beasts! Created to promote awareness for these majestic (and not really all that slow creatures) and the dangers they face due to pollution and habitat destruction, it's also a great opportunity to appreciate the myriad of chelonians out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/afb81bc73c6293717e3c0bdf58b99929cf253ac4.jpg[/img]

Why stick to a day though? We're celebrating for a whole week! From now [b]until May 30[/b] at 10:59 am CEST, your [b]Galapagos Tortoises[/b] and [b]Leatherback Sea Turtles[/b] will grant [b]500% more experience points[/b]!

[b][i]Happy Turtle Day![/i][/b]

Your [b]My Free Zoo[/b] Team

notes.title: Mother's Day Event!
notes.notes:
Flowers, beautiful landscapes, and lots of peace and quiet - Sweden has everything a mother could want (and some delicious food to boot!). Come to Scandinavia with us for this year's [b]Mother's Day Event[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/fc622685344831d3623bd938ab0c54617a27c0a4.jpg[/img]

For the duration of the event, you'll find the [b]seasonal section of your shop[/b] stocked with beautiful Swedish plants and specialties for Mother's Day. The selection includes a variety of lupines, trees, houses and vendors to brighten up your zoo!

Each Mother's Day decoration you place in your zoo will give you points in the form of [b]Meatballs[/b].

This time around, you can also [b]help out your friends[/b] by surprising them with card pieces from the [b]Friendship Gift Shop[/b]! Send them pieces of a dala horse or stave church to help them out!

Collecting enough Meatballs before the event ends on [b]May 15 at 10:59 am CEST[/b] will allow you to earn some exciting rewards, including a brand-new animal species - the [b]Squirrel Monkey[/b]- and last year's prize, the [b]Golden Pheasant[/b]!

[b]5,000 Meatballs[/b] - Silver Booster
[b]10,000 Meatballs[/b] - Golden Pheasant
[b]20,000 Meatballs[/b] - Squirrel Monkey
[b]60,000 Meatballs[/b] - Golden Pheasant Squirrel Monkey
[b]80,000 Meatballs[/b] - Squirrel Monkey

[b]Squirrel Monkey[/b]s are social animals, living in the trees of the rainforests in Central and Southern America in groups of up to 500 members. They eat mostly  fruits and insects, but can also eat other plant parts and small vertebrates. In your zoo, it can be kept in forest and jungle enclosures, where it will feel right at home in groups of up to 12. Each one needs six units of space.

[b]Please note:[/b] [b]Only decorations placed in your zoo when the event ends on May 15, 2018, at 10:59 am CEST will count towards your reward. Items in your inventory will not count! So make sure to place everything you buy IN YOUR ZOO.[/b]

notes.title: Zoological Time Traveling!
notes.notes:
The Natural History Museum and the Zoological Society have teamed up to create a place for all those Museum animals you've brought back from extinction: the all-new Prehistoric Park region!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/3023975004b06ce8cddf4da07d2f6dcc3ba83160.jpg[/img]

The [b]Prehistoric Park[/b] is a brand-new region that allows you to created [b]mixed species exhibits[/b] in a magnificent prehistoric setting.

In addition to allowing you to create unique enclosures with mixed communities of extinct animals, the Prehistoric Park will attract significantly more visitors. There are also special decorations for your Prehistoric Park (some for enclosures, some for outside) as well as themed stalls so your visitors can enjoy a real blast from the past!

[b]Unlocking the Prehistoric Park[/b]

To gain access to the Prehistoric Park, you must have a [b]Zoological Society[/b] in your zoo. This building grants you access to regions with special properties, such as the the Zoo d'Amour, the Serengeti, and the new Prehistoric Park.

To unlock the Prehistoric Park, you must first complete some prerequisite tasks:

- Breed 10 Dodos
- Breed 10 Woolly Mammoths
- Breed 10 Smilodons
- Breed 10 Ankylosaurus
[i][b]Note:[/b] You can skip this task for 290 Diamonds (or less, if you've already completed some of it), but this will only skip the prerequisite. You will not get any baby animals, nor will you get credit for achievements that involve breeding these animals. You are only paying to [b]skip the prerequisite[/b]![/i]

Once these tasks are complete, you can[b] unlock the Prehistoric Park for either 40,000,000 ZD or 175 Diamonds[/b].

[b]Expanding and Populating the Prehistoric Park[/b]

Your Prehistoric Park starts out with a size of [b]20x20 fields[/b] with a number of obstacles that need to be removed to make room for enclosures. Some of these cost Diamonds to remove.

Of course, there are also a number of expansions for the region unlockable for either Zoo-Dollars or Diamonds. Animals in the Prehistoric Park require special [b]Prehistoric Park enclosures[/b], which can be purchased in the shop while in the Prehistoric Park. While regular space limits apply, there is [b]no herd limit[/b] within Prehistoric Park enclosures, allowing you to keep impressive herds of mammoths!

[b][i]At time of release, the Prehistoric Park can be home to the following species:[/i][/b]
Haast's Eagle, Moa, Quagga, Giant Ground Sloth, Thylacine, Woolly Rhinoceros, Dodo, Glyptodon, Triceratops, Ankylosaurus, Bear Dog, Deinotherium, Terrorbird, Woolly Mammoth, Quetzalcoatlus, Smilodon, Paraceratherium, Tyrannosaurus

[b]Breeding in the Prehistoric Park[/b]

As breeding in mixed species enclosures is too stressful for the animals, breeding animals in the Prehistoric Park requires special breeding enclosures, in which you can only keep a single species. These can be purchased in the shop and outfitted with prehistoric breeding equipment (watering hole and habitation).

Back in the dens, new mothers are taking care of the more helpless cubs, kits, and kittens. Yep, another [b]Twin Breeding Event[/b] has begun with today's patch!

notes.title: New Museum Animals for the Cretaceous
notes.notes:
12 meters of muscle, weighing up to 7 tonnes - These gargantuan creatures could have skulls that were 1.5 meters long with 30 cm long teeth. [b]Tyrannosaurs[/b] is one of the most impressive dinosaurs to have ever lived. Now you can get this bipedal apex predator for your zoo!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/fb4a3e30bf9bba9207976138745eb1f911b6d479.jpg[/img]

This is how it works: At [b]museum level 7[/b] you can unlock the [b]Cretaceous[/b]. Send out paleontologists to find fossils of Cretaceous creatures. Once you have found enough [b]fossil pieces[/b] of a given dinosaur, you can assemble the [b]skeleton[/b] and put it up for display in your zoo or museum.

You can then begin using newly acquired fossil card pieces for research to obtain a [b]living specimen[/b]. These prehistoric giants are sure to impress your visitors!

Before you can get tyrannosaurus fossils and animal pieces, you'll need [b]complete skeletons[/b] of the previous dinosaurs: Ankylosaurus, Triceratops, Quetzalcoatlus and Plesiosaurus.

[b]Plesiosaurus[/b] is likewise new in My Free Zoo. It lived in the ocean and had a long, broad body, paddle-shaped fins, a long neck and a small head. It is believed to have primarily eaten fish and grew to be up to 5 meters long.

Stop by your zoo now! You'll fidn everything you need to know about these enormous reptiles there. We wish you lots of gigantic fun in the zoo!

notes.title: Rawr! New dinosaurs for your museum!
notes.notes:
New fossils have been found! Pack your digging equipment and head on over to the Natural History Museum! 

Players that have unlocked the [b]Cretaceous[/b] and have completed fossils of the [b]Ankylosaurus[/b], [b]Triceratops[/b] and [b]Quetzalcoatlus[/b] can now find fossils of two new dinosaurs!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/fb4a3e30bf9bba9207976138745eb1f911b6d479.jpg[/img]

[b]Plesiosaurus[/b]
Large marine reptiles, Plesiosaurs lived during the early part of the Jurassic period. Growing to be roughly 3.5 meters in length, they had broad, turtle-like bodies, small heads, long necks and two pairs of large paddles. 
It will take you 14 fossil pieces to complete a skeleton, and 16 animal card pieces to bring this mighty creature back to life. 
[b]Additional Info[/b]
[spoiler][b]Enclosure Type:[/b] Water
[b]Space Requirement:[/b] 40
[b]Max per Enclosure:[/b] 4
[b]Breeding Costs:[/b] 400,000 ZD
[b]Breeding Chance:[/b] 1%
[b]Breeding Duration:[/b] 1,440 minutes
[b]EXP for Care:[/b] 320[/spoiler]

[b]Tyrannosaurus Rex[/b]
Probably the most iconic and well-known dinosaur, [i]Tyrannosaurus rex[/i] was one of the last non-avian dinosaurs. These gargantuan beasts were likely apex predators in their time. The largest complete specimen was over 12 meters long.
It will take you 15 fossil pieces to complete a skeleton, and 18 animal card pieces to bring this imposing giant back to life.
[b]Additional Info[/b]
[spoiler][b]Enclosure Type:[/b] Grassland, Rock, Savanna
[b]Space Requirement:[/b] 12
[b]Max per Enclosure:[/b] 4
[b]Breeding Costs:[/b] 500,000 ZD
[b]Breeding Chance:[/b] 1%
[b]Breeding Duration:[/b] 2,880 minutes
[b]EXP for Care:[/b] 400[/spoiler]

If you're not quite at the dinosaur-reanimating stage of your zoo career, you might be happy to hear that one of their very distant relatives is now available in the zoo shop once more: The [b]Red-Crowned Crane/b] (the 2016 Valentine's animal) is now available at [b]level 44[/b] for 80 Diamonds!

notes.title: The Hit Zoo Celebrates its 6th Anniversary
notes.notes:
It started six years ago today - with a small zoo and a big dream. Zoo director Welmington opened his first zoo. He laid paths, built an enclosure and put his first animal up for display: a cute little sheep.

 Since then, the tiny zoo has evolved into an animal lover's paradise. There are now over 250 animals in My Free Zoo, even prehistoric giants such as dinosaurs and woolly mammoths.

 The game has captivated millions of people in 18 languages since its launch six years ago. And every day, more players join. [b]That calls for a celebration![/b]. Log into My Free Zoo to pick up your [b]birthday present[/b]. We don't want to spoil the surprise, but it's cute, small, and hops through your zoo!

Come stop by before [b]Wednesday, February 7[/b] to secure your special [b]birthday surprise[/b], which will make you regular gifts of experience points and Zoo Dollars!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/f64d1f8d64606f66594c291a5519ba8920c37969.jpg[/img]

If you successfully complete a [b]Penguin, Rockhopper Penguin or Adélie Penguin breeding[/b] between [b]Friday, January 19, at 11:00 am and Saturday, January 20 at 10:59 am CET[/b], you'll receive adorable [b]penguin triplets[/b]. Even if you breeding fails, you'll still get twice as many experience points.

[b]NOTE[/b]: Your breeding needs to [b]complete during the event[/b], so between Friday, January 19, at 11:00 am and Saturday, January 20 at 10:59 am CET, for you to receive triplets. If a breeding takes longer than 24 hours, you need to start it before Friday, January 19, to be able to get triplets from the event. If you breeding completes after Saturday, January 20, at 11:00 am CET, you will only get a single baby.

Come stop by My Free Zoo - you'll find everything you need to know in the game!

notes.title: Get Free Silver and Gold Boosters!
notes.notes:
What a great start to the year! From [b]Thursday, January 11th[/b] at 12:01 am CET [b]until Wednesday, January 17[/b], at 11:59 pm CET, you'll get valuable [b]gold and silver boosters[/b] instead of the regular bronze ones for your [b]daily login[/b]!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/d71c0bc52e4c0ab06046cac3074e4326c5d6b497.jpg[/img]

This is how it works: [b]Log in daily[/b] to collect your free [b]silver booster[/b]. If you log in 3 days in a row and pick up your daily Silver Booster, you'll even get a [b]free Gold Booster[/b] from the [b]4th day[/b] onwards. Each additional consecutive day will give you another Gold Booster until the event ends.

 If you miss one or more days, you'll be reset back to a silver booster for the rest of the event.

 Come stop by your zoo and secure yourself silver and gold boosters! Let's go!

notes.title: My Free Zoo – Now with collector‘s cards!
notes.notes:
Dear players,
Great news, everyone! Starting now, you can obtain collector’s cards in My Free Zoo.
If you’re hard at work in the game and support us, you collect lovely trading cards picturing animals as you go along.
Once you have all 15 cards, you can craft badges and thus unlock special emoticons or game backgrounds.
So, as you see, playing My Free Zoo now is even more worthwhile!
Keep having fun playing My Free Zoo and collect your awesome collector’s cards!
